title: Store-House

inlines.v: STORE-HOUSE, noun [store and house.] 1. A building for keeping grain or goods of any kind; a magazine; a repository; a warehouse. Joseph opened all the store-houses and sold to the Egyptians. Genesis 41:1. 2. A repository. The Scripture of God is a store-house abounding with inestimable treasures of wisdom and knowledge. 3. A great mass reposited. [Not in use.]
